sloka: वैदेह्याः प्रिय कामेन कृतम् कर्म जटायुषा ।गृध्र राजेन यत् तत्र श्रुतम् वः तत् अशेषतः ॥४-५६-९॥
transliteration: vaidehyāḥ priya kāmena kṛtam karma jaṭāyuṣā ।gṛdhra rājena yat tatra śrutam vaḥ tat aśeṣataḥ ॥4-56-9॥

translations.english: 'We have heard in detail about the task accomplished by Jatayu, the king of vultures, in order to please Sita, the princess of Videha.
